en.prompt: Write a brief editorial memo in English for an editor working on a Korean exhibit about Seoul’s 2024 youth Climate Card pilot. The draft says ‘지우와 민서는 지금 환급금을 받아요’. At the time, each completed 30-day pass used without a refund could qualify for a 7,000-won refund. Physical cards counted only after registration; mobile cards required no separate card registration. Both types required a refund application. Assume all other eligibility conditions were met. Jiwoo completed a first physical pass before registration, completed the second after registration, and refunded a third on day 18. Minseo completed two mobile passes without refund. Explain how much each could have applied for and why. Explain the time and payment implication in the draft and suggest a short Korean 해요체 phrase to fix it. Keep the editorial explanation in English; retain Korean where discussing the actual wording.
checks: Correctly gives Jiwoo 7,000 won, counting only the second pass and explaining why the unregistered and refunded passes do not count.
Correctly gives Minseo 14,000 won for two completed passes; distinguishes not having to register the mobile card from having to apply for either refund.
Explains the draft's timing and payment implications in English and proposes Korean 해요체 wording that conveys past eligibility to apply without implying current entitlement or automatic payment.

ko.prompt: 서울의 2024년 기후동행카드 시범사업을 다룬 전시 문구를 편집합니다. 초안은 ‘지우와 민서는 지금 환급금을 받아요’입니다. 당시 청년 할인 대상자는 실물카드 등록 후 이용분이나 별도 등록이 필요 없는 모바일카드 이용분 중 환불 없이 30일 만기를 채운 달마다 7,000원을 신청할 수 있었고, 두 카드 모두 환급을 별도로 신청해야 했어요. 연령 등 나머지 조건은 충족했다고 가정합니다. 지우는 실물카드 첫 30일권을 미등록 상태로 끝까지 쓴 뒤 등록하고, 둘째 권은 만기까지, 셋째 권은 18일째 환불했어요. 민서는 모바일카드 두 장을 각각 30일 만기까지 썼어요. 편집자에게 한국어로 짧은 메모를 써 주세요. 두 사람이 얼마를 신청할 수 있었는지와 그 이유를 밝히고, 초안이 잘못 전달하는 시점과 자동 지급 여부를 바로잡을 해요체 표현을 제시해 주세요.
checks: 지우는 등록 후 만기를 채운 둘째 권만 해당해 7,000원이며, 첫 권과 셋째 권은 각각 미등록과 중도 환불로 제외됨을 설명한다.
민서는 만기 두 번으로 14,000원이고, 모바일카드 등록 면제와 두 종류 모두 별도의 환급 신청이 필요했던 점을 구분한다.
2024년 당시 신청할 수 있었다는 뜻을 전달하는 해요체 표현을 제시하고, 현재 신청 가능이나 자동 지급을 암시하는 원문의 문제를 고친다.

en.answer:
## Editorial memo

Revise **“지우와 민서는 지금 환급금을 받아요”** (“Jiwoo and Minseo receive refunds now”). It sounds like they receive money now, and that refunds are automatic. The pilot required an application, and the amounts below were what they could have applied for at the time.

- **Jiwoo: 7,000 won.** The first physical pass was completed before card registration, so it did not qualify. The second was completed after registration and was not refunded, so it qualified. The third pass was refunded on day 18; it did not meet the 30-day requirement.
- **Minseo: 14,000 won.** Both completed mobile passes were used without a refund and qualified. Mobile cards did not need separate card registration.

Suggested short 해요체 wording: **“두 사람은 환급금을 신청할 수 있었어요.”** This marks the opportunity as past and says they could apply, without implying that they received payment.

X_notes: X gives Jiwoo 7,000 won and excludes the unregistered first pass and refunded third pass.
X gives Minseo 14,000 won and distinguishes mobile registration from the required refund application.
X explains that the draft implies receiving money now and suggests 해요체 wording that conveys an opportunity to apply, not payment received.
Y_notes: Y gives Jiwoo 7,000 won and explains why the first and third passes do not qualify.
Y gives Minseo 14,000 won and notes that mobile cards need no separate registration while the pilot requires an application.
Y explains the present-payment implication and suggests past-tense 해요체 wording that describes an opportunity to apply without claiming payment.

At the time of the 2024 pilot, each completed 30-day pass used without a refund could qualify for a 7,000-won refund, provided the card was registered when required and a refund application was submitted.
